units.source_text: 藤壶皇后听见源氏公子的话句句中肯，一时心绪缭乱，无言可答。

en.t: When Empress Fujitsubo heard how every word Prince Genji spoke was to the point, her heart was thrown into confusion for a time, and she had no reply.

units.source_text: 源氏公子寻思过去未来千头万绪之事，伤心之极，掩面而泣，其神情凄艳无比。

en.t: Prince Genji thought over the countless tangled matters of past and future, and in the depths of grief covered his face and wept; his expression was heartbreakingly beautiful beyond compare.

units.source_text: 后来收泪问道：“我今即将前往拜墓，不知母后有何传言否？”

en.t: After a while he dried his tears and asked, "I am about to go to pay my respects at the grave. I wonder whether Mother has any message to send."

units.source_text: 藤壶皇后悲伤之极，一时不能答语，但努力作镇静的模样。

en.t: Empress Fujitsubo was overcome with grief and for a time could not answer, but she tried hard to appear composed.
